comment:
* This represents the Issuer Alternative Name Extension. * * This extension, if present, allows the issuer to specify multiple * alternative names. * *

Extensions are represented as a sequence of the extension identifier * (Object Identifier), a boolean flag stating whether the extension is to * be treated as being critical and the extension value itself (this is again * a DER encoding of the extension value). * * @author Amit Kapoor * @author Hemma Prafullchandra * @see Extension * @see CertAttrSet
